[[Arrahhsh Mountainclub]] is a [[Yeti]] [[warrior]] [[boss]] who appears in [[Pongmei Valley]]. He also [[spawn]]s in [[Mount Qinkai]] during [[Return of the Yeti]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Pongmei Valley}}
* [[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Mount Qinkai}} (only during [[Return of the Yeti]])

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Battle Rage}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Counter Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Heavy Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Staggering Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Yeti Smash}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Arrahhsh's Aegis]] ([[unique]])
* [[Fur Square]]
* [[Golden Lantern]] (only in Mount Qinkai)
* [[Stolen Provisions]]
* [[Yeti Plating]]

== Notes ==
* During Return of the Yeti, Arrahhsh Mountainclub ''also'' appears in Mount Qinkai. You ''cannot'' obtain the Golden Lantern from his usual spawn in Pongmei Valley. That quest item can only be found in his Mount Qinkai spawn.
